messages.subject: Gradient color for bar graph
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

I would like to make a bar graph with error bars for a factor with 5
levels but with the filling color of the bars on a grey gradient with a
different grey color for each level of the factor (the gradient could be
from white to black).

df = data.frame(Categor�a = factor(c("Insecto", "Reptil", "Cangrejo",
"Camar�n", "Peces"), levels = c("Insecto", "Reptil", "Cangrejo",
"Camar�n", "Peces")), Proportion = c(0.84, 0.42, 21.76, 15.90, 61.09))

limites = aes(ymax = c(3.00, 2.31, 27.53, 21.16, 67.00), ymin = c(0.00,
0.00, 17.00, 11.5, 54.00))

p <- ggplot(df, aes(y = Proportion, x = Categor�a))
p + geom_bar() + geom_errorbar(limites, width=0.25)

Thank you very much in advance.
Best,

Manuel

hi,

Try

last_plot() + aes(fill=Categoría) + scale_fill_grey()

HTH,

baptiste
